limitations: Units, items, abilities, buffs, upgrades, destructables and doodads: each kind's SLK sheets and its profiles, joined by object id (units join five sheets). AbilityBuffData.slk, typed w3h changes and native Bufftip/Buffubertip profile declarations identify buffs; shared ability-profile sections route to the buff namespace, including custom buffs. An ID declared as both ability and buff has its ambiguous profile diagnosed and left unassigned. Generic Art/Name and rawcode prefixes do not classify buffs; otherwise undeclared profile IDs retain the ability-profile namespace.

An imported Units/*.slk or profile replaces the game's file whole. Binary changes war3map.*, war3mapSkin.* and war3campaign.* apply in that same-root order over the tables; later workspace roots retain precedence. Fields use metadata IDs, custom objects inherit their base; w3h uses the buff namespace and AbilityBuffMetaData.slk. Missing metadata is diagnosed, not guessed. Version 3 has an opaque integer array before one change list; only empty/single-zero headers are admitted for resolved data, other headers are diagnosed without partial application.

String changes resolve whole TRIGSTR_<n> references through war3map.wts or war3campaign.wts of their root scope. Missing strings remain authored and are diagnosed. Values retain the binary change as their field source; navigation to the WTS declaration is not provided yet. AbilitySkin and UnitWeaponsSkin profiles are optional inputs.

List fields the metadata types as units, items, abilities, buffs or upgrades are relations (trains, builds, researches, abilities, sold items), scoped to their object kind. Conditional useSpecific/notSpecific rows and conflicting row types do not become universal links or scalar enums. Requirements and per-level ability columns are not linked yet; native numeric types, units and defaults are pending. Other values are the text the file writes.

Optional UI/UnitEditorData.txt supplies native unitRace/moveType scalar enum IDs through DataSchemaField.type, with whole-file overlay precedence. Other editor domains may be bitmasks or multi-value fields and are not inferred as scalar enums. Display-string keys and additional columns are not members or localized labels; version/mode-dependent filtering is not implemented. Indexed, repeated, conditional or conflicting metadata rows and values outside the native scalar domain remain untyped with their raw values preserved; malformed enum domains are diagnosed. This is schema publication, not typed editing or field-navigation acceptance.
